I need an illustration of beautiful sisters who are original alchemists.
They are alchemists in a bright fantasy world like in the Atelier series of Gust games. They are wearing cute outfits. Her legs are very revealing, and she is wearing an outfit that exposes her breasts a little. She fights demons.
My sister is in her mid-twenties in age, has long flaxen hair (more than shoulder-length), is in the 160cm range in height, and has a good style. Her personality is calm and gentle.
The younger sister is in her early 20s, has silver hair (length is up to you), is under 150 cm tall, and has a fuller chest than the older sister. She has a gentle personality, though she is not very expressive.
They run a store selling magical tools created by alchemy and go outdoors to gather materials.
Please create a standing picture, a scene of them in the store, or a scene of them going out to gather materials, whichever you prefer.
Thank you in advance.
